role: Provider-Neutral Context Assembly, Policy Enforcement & Minimization Layer
target_consumer: E-7 Task Intelligence Orchestration & Planning Layer

boundary_separation.upstream_adapters: Provider-specific integration boundaries (e.g. ERPSourceAdapter) executing approved, read-only parameterized source queries, normalizing records, stamping provenance, and returning typed SourceContextBundle objects.
boundary_separation.context_builder: Provider-neutral assembly, policy evaluation, and data-minimization layer. Verifies organization scope, selects approved adapters, enforces field access policies, minimizes context strictly to goal needs, isolates validation evidence, handles aggregates, and produces structured ContextAssemblyResult.
boundary_separation.task_intelligence_orchestration: Consumes structured model_context from ContextAssemblyResult. Formats serialized model prompt templates, handles LLM API communication, and passes model proposals to deterministic validators.
boundary_separation.deterministic_validators: Validates PlanSchema compliance, resolves opaque references against internal validation_context through validated E-7 canonical/source mappings, executes dependency-reference validation, DAG cycle detection, and computes CPM/slack/critical-path analysis.
boundary_separation.postgresql: Canonical System of Record for persisted operational state, canonical/source mappings, outbox/inbox events, and audit ledgers.

supported_context_categories.description: Organizational department association and job designations. Descriptive context only; does not establish operational eligibility, capability, or authorization.
Academic sessions, classes, sections, and class-section cohort structures. Bounded strictly to goal-relevant target cohorts.
Course catalogue, subject codes, instructional types (Theory vs Practical), and curricular groupings.

Relevant normalized staff context, qualifications, work experience, and opaque reference tokens (<opaque_staff_ref>). Human names conditional under policy. Descriptive attributes do NOT prove task eligibility, capability, or invigilator suitability. RBAC roles (roles, staff_roles) are validation-only.
Published timetable periods representing known busy windows. Scheduled period = known busy commitment; absence of timetable entry != complete availability.
Informational holiday and academic event schedules. Informational dates do not constitute automated hard constraints or blackouts without explicit business policy.

Approved adapter-derived mathematical headcounts (e.g. cohort student count). Individual student rows and columns are not exposed to the model for the current Task Intelligence scope and policy version.

deferred_or_gated_categories.reason: Forward staff availability modeling deferred to Phase 2/4. Historical attendance daily punch logs (staff_attendance) are not exposed to the model and do not establish future availability.
Upstream ERP schema lacks canonical physical academic room masters. Gated by BLK-02.
Upstream ERP schema contains zero room or seating capacity fields. Must not be fabricated. Gated by BLK-02.
Upstream ERP schema contains zero laboratory or instructional equipment inventory.
Upstream ERP schema lacks invigilation certification, training, or examination duty eligibility models.
Operational authority between CBSE and Legacy exam subsystems unresolved (UBQ-TI-03). Physical room scheduling gated by BLK-02.

required_concepts: correlation_id: Distributed tracing correlation identifier linking context assembly to high-level goal workflow.
authenticated_actor_reference: Authenticated caller/principal reference established by core security.
organization_scope_reference: Authoritative tenant/organization scope partition. Mandatory for production context assembly (BLK-01).
goal_reference: Operational goal identifier or goal input reference.
bounded_goal_scope: Operational goal descriptor bounding retrieval scope.
requested_context_categories: Explicit list of logical context categories requested.
mapping_version: Task 0G.2 source mapping version applied.
access_policy_version: Task 0G.3 AI Context Access Policy version applied.
optional_concepts: normalized_selectors: Provider-neutral domain selectors (e.g. normalized academic session reference, normalized class references, normalized section references, normalized department references, normalized subject references, opaque staff references).
temporal_scope: Operational planning window (planning_window_start, planning_window_end in ISO-8601 UTC).
requested_as_of: Point-in-time timestamp for historical or temporal context where applicable.
freshness_tolerance: Maximum allowable freshness class threshold before context is flagged DEGRADED.
disallowed_concepts: Raw database table names or column names.
Raw database primary keys or SQL fragments.
Arbitrary SQL queries or dynamic WHERE clauses.
Database host, port, credentials, or DSN parameters.
Unbounded requests ('give me all data', 'dump all staff').
LLM system or developer prompt templates.

sections.description: Structured domain data permitted for model exposure. Bounded strictly to goal scope, whitelisted fields, opaque references, and sanitized text.
Internal-only evidence for deterministic validators (raw source IDs, relational bindings, status/lifecycle flags, timing metadata). Strictly isolated from LLM visibility.
Approved mathematical headcount calculations (e.g. cohort student count). Zero individual student records exposed.
Audit metadata detailing source systems, entity types, external references, timestamps, freshness classes, mapping versions, and policy decisions.
Explicit record of requested or available fields/categories intentionally omitted, including policy denial reasons and minimization rules applied.
Structured diagnostic alerts detailing non-fatal issues (stale optional context, missing non-critical records, partial category availability).
Ambiguities, conflicting source claims, or missing critical parameters requiring human review or administrative clarification.
Provider-neutral operational assembly outcome enum: READY, DEGRADED, BLOCKED, or REQUIRES_CLARIFICATION.

assembly_statuses.definition: All required context for this goal was successfully assembled, validated against policy, and minimized within approved rules. Safe for Task Intelligence planning.
Planning may proceed under approved policy, but non-critical context is incomplete, stale, or partially unavailable. Condition explicitly surfaced in warnings.
A mandatory security prerequisite, organization scope rule, source connectivity, schema compatibility, or critical context condition prevents safe planning.
The system cannot safely resolve source conflicts, ambiguous mappings, or policy gates using available evidence alone. Human or administrative clarification is required.

policy_precedence: 1. Authenticated Principal & Scope Verification: Must possess verified organization_scope_reference (BLK-01).

2. Source Adapter Capability & Health Validation: Category must be marked SUPPORTED by an approved adapter, and adapter/source health state must be acceptable for the current category and goal under policy.
3. Task 0G.2 Mapping Authorization: Source table and fields must be mapped as REQUIRED_FOR_INITIAL_TI or AGGREGATE_ONLY.

4. Task 0G.3 Access Policy Whitelisting (Model Context): Field must be classified as PLANNER_CONTEXT_ALLOWED (max 28 fields) or AGGREGATE_ONLY for model-visible inclusion. (DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION_ONLY fields remain authorized strictly for internal validation_context).
5. Context Category Goal Relevance: Category must be demonstrably relevant to the operational goal.
6. Goal-Scoped Minimization: Records must be filtered strictly to the bounded target cohorts, departments, or temporally scoped window relevant to the active goal.
7. Conditional Identity Rules: Personal identifiers (name, surname) masked to opaque tokens (<opaque_staff_ref>) unless explicitly authorized.
8. Freshness & Staleness Policy: Context freshness must satisfy goal tolerance; required stale context may result in BLOCKED or DEGRADED according to policy and goal criticality.
9. Untrusted Text Handling: Approved free text enters model context as untrusted data literals without instruction authority; suspicious text is quarantined or omitted.

failure_semantics.action: Reject request immediately; fail closed without querying adapters (BLK-01).

failure_semantics.trigger: Required source adapter UNAVAILABLE or MISCONFIGURED
failure_semantics.action: Halt context assembly for goals dependent on critical source.
Fail closed on affected categories; emit schema drift security alert.

failure_semantics.trigger: Requested category marked DEFERRED or UNSUPPORTED
failure_semantics.action: Block if category is required for goal; omit with warning if optional.

failure_semantics.trigger: Policy denial on restricted or forbidden field
failure_semantics.action: Omit field immediately; record in omissions ledger; fail closed if field was mandatory.

failure_semantics.trigger: Missing required entity (e.g. session or cohort not found)
failure_semantics.action: Halt assembly; do not synthesize or fabricate missing entities.

failure_semantics.trigger: Stale required context exceeding operational tolerance
failure_semantics.action: Halt planning if freshness is declared critical by policy; otherwise omit or degrade per policy.
Include with structured warning in warnings section or omit per policy.
Block if headcount is mandatory for capacity/effort; otherwise omit with warning.
Do not silently merge or pick arbitrary winner; record conflict in unresolved_questions; block if clarification is required.

failure_semantics.trigger: Suspicious upstream text or prompt injection attempt
failure_semantics.action: Quarantine suspicious text; treat approved free text as untrusted data; emit security audit evidence.

production_blockers.title: Tenant / Organization Partitioning Rule Unresolved
production_blockers.impact: Live production context retrieval against upstream MySQL remains strictly blocked until authoritative tenant/organization scoping mechanism is defined. Synthetic/mock scope references permitted for testing.

production_blockers.title: SCHEDULING / EXAM RESOURCE PRODUCTION GATE: Physical Academic Resource Authority Unresolved
production_blockers.impact: Unresolved room capacity and equipment authority blocks production capabilities requiring authoritative physical resource scheduling (e.g. automated room/seat allocation). Does NOT block general Task Intelligence goal decomposition, WBS generation, or academic context retrieval.

unresolved_decisions.title: Tenant / Organization Scoping Blocker
unresolved_decisions.rule: Production context retrieval remains blocked until an authoritative organization/tenant partition rule is defined.

unresolved_decisions.title: Active and Soft-Delete Semantics
unresolved_decisions.rule: Allowed active/status flag semantics must follow authoritative business mappings; where status semantics are unresolved, Context Builder must report ambiguity or a business-confirmation gate; no universal is_active meaning is invented.

unresolved_decisions.title: Examination Subsystem Operational Authority
unresolved_decisions.rule: Designate whether CBSE exam subsystem or Legacy exam subsystem is authoritative for curriculum workflows before exam context integration.

unresolved_decisions.title: Physical Academic Resource Source Authority
unresolved_decisions.rule: Confirm whether physical resources are owned in E-7 PostgreSQL (Universal Mode) or supplied by external facilities systems (Embedded Mode) before exam room scheduling.

unresolved_decisions.title: Future Staff Availability vs Historical Attendance Semantics
unresolved_decisions.rule: Forward availability relies strictly on approved leave requests and published timetables; historical attendance punch logs excluded.
